items.prompt: For disjoint masks x=5 (0101) and y=10 (1010), what should classify return for this one pair?

options.why: Nonzero inputs can be disjoint. The task counts common positions, not whether either input is nonzero.

options.text: ["EVEN"], because their intersection has zero set bits.
options.why: 0101 AND 1010 is zero; population count zero is even, and the pair still emits a line.

options.text: [], because zero intersections produce no output.
options.why: The function returns one classification per pair, including pairs with no common bits.
Union and nonzero tests are not the required population count of common positions. Their intersection is zero.
